description: Patch, digest and pinning updates are the ones not meant to change behaviour; Renovate merges them once the pull request's checks pass, and the weekly release picks them up as a patch release. GitHub's auto-merge is not enabled here and its settings are not changed for this

packageRules.description: A new Go minor in the go directive raises the Go every user of go install needs, and CI follows it through go-version-file. It waits for approval on the dashboard; patches flow as usual
